title: LifecycleConfiguration
description: Optional presentation metadata for guided lifecycle workflows. Executable nodes and edges remain authoritative; editors must verify that the metadata compiles to the saved graph before editing it as stages.

checks.description: Fields the asset must fill in before it can leave the stage.

conditions.description: JSON Logic condition the asset must also meet before it can leave the stage.

task.description: Who is asked to fill in the missing fields or get the conditions met. Without it the stage holds the asset and asks no one (ADR:2026-10-15-a-lifecycle-stage-asks-for-its-missing-metadata-in-one-task).

lifecycleGate.description: A stage of the guided lifecycle: the fields and conditions an asset needs before it can leave the stage, and who is asked to complete them.

lifecycleFieldCheck.description: A field the asset must fill in before it can leave the gate's stage.

valueType.description: Number and boolean fields accept zero and false as filled-in values.
